title: giwf-weeklywar-1995-world-heavyweight
label: Sal DeFazio

won.source: GIWF's own 5 March 1996 Weekly War, retold on-air: 'Sal DeFazio won the GIWF World Title from Lonestar on that card in Juarez, Mexico.'

end.source: GIWF's own served 23 January 1996 title-lineage snapshot: 'THE BOD" THESEUS DEVLIN - Won on Weekly War on 1-6-95 w/ Mr. Christopher Andrews by forcing Sal DeFazio to sumbit.'

note: The snapshot's own source text misdates this win '1-6-95'; internal chronology (after the 7 Dec 1995 Juarez show, before the 23 Jan 1996 snapshot) places it 6 January 1996, corrected here rather than reproduced as a typo.

title: giwf-weeklywar-1995-world-heavyweight
label: Theseus Devlin

won.source: GIWF's own served 23 January 1996 title-lineage snapshot, dated (see note on r002).
